verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents role-based permissions or any way to limit investigation or administrative actions by role. The nearest items are OAuth2 client-credential API tokens, revoking credentials in the UI, and assigning cases to a person. These are adjacent authentication and workflow features, not role-based access control. For a compliance and AML platform this axis clearly applies, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can restrict investigation and administrative actions to appropriate roles
